{{Top|leg}}
'''Kadavo ore''' was a [[Color/Legends|red]]&ndash;bluish purple ore mined on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]] by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the other [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in the slave work camps.<ref name="episode">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref> An average piece could fit into a [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] hand.<ref name="guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep413|text="Escape from Kadavo" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:KadavoOreConceptArt-SWcom.jpg|thumb|right|Kadavo ore concept artwork.]]
Kadavo ore first appeared in "[[Escape from Kadavo]],"<ref name="episode" /> the thirteenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|season four]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', and was identified in the corresponding episode guide.<ref name="guide" />
